About Genpop
Genpop Interactive is 25 people who are dead set on trying to give gamers something that AAA studios can't; heavy iteration from player feedback. Where AAA studios play it safe and optimize for predictability, Genpop embraces the chaos of creativity,  thriving on experimentation—adjusting, evolving, and pushing boundaries to create something we want to play.

As you know, game development is at a crux right now and indie studios like Genpop are becoming more and more rare. If you legitimately like SLiMECORE and think it has potential, we urge you to be a part of it. Play, chat, send memes, follow and share what you like. This is crucial as it indicates that gamers want content like SLiMECORE. We honestly need you.

The dev team is always available and we're open to your ideas!
